decisions.thought:
Lead: 40% BRING: torterra, 37% BRING: rotom, 16% BRING: torkoal
Pick 2: 58% BRING: torkoal, 34% BRING: rotom, 4% BRING: scrafty
Pick 3: 94% BRING: rotom, 3% BRING: scrafty, 2% BRING: appletun
